setting: You all live in the same market town in the English Midlands and run the local parkrun together most Saturdays, so you know each other from the start line, the tail-end chat and the post-run coffee.
openers: Send a photo of the course

Chloe.knows: You know Keith, Julie, Adam and Jean from the Saturday parkrun, and you have all chatted at the finish line for years.
Chloe.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something is happening at parkrun.
Chloe.style: Some emoji and a few abbreviations.

Keith.knows: You know Chloe, Julie, Adam and Jean from parkrun, and you see Jean every day at home.
Keith.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to say you have seen the results or are heading to the course.
Keith.style: Few emoji and hardly any abbreviations.

Julie.knows: You know Chloe, Keith, Adam and Jean from parkrun, and you have run with Chloe for years.
Julie.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to swap news about the run.
Julie.style: Some emoji and a few abbreviations.

Adam.knows: You know Chloe, Keith, Julie and Jean from parkrun, and you help Keith's son with the odd job on his car.
Adam.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when you are running late or have a spare slot to join in.
Adam.style: Some emoji and a few abbreviations.

Jean.knows: You know Chloe, Keith, Julie and Adam from parkrun, and you are married to Keith.
Jean.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to remind everyone about the run or share a photo.
Jean.style: Few emoji and hardly any abbreviations.

private_lines.Chloe: You teach Year 3 at the primary school across town, and your evenings go to marking and planning. You live with your partner and two cats in a terraced house, and you usually get out for a run before school on weekdays.
private_lines.Keith: You work as a hospital porter on rotating shifts, moving patients and equipment around the wards. You live with Jean in a semi-detached house on the edge of town, and when you are not on shift you potter in the garden and walk the dog.
private_lines.Julie: You are a pharmacist at the high street branch, working long days and some Saturdays. You live alone in a flat above a shop near the town centre, and your free time goes to reading, cooking and a weekly swim.
private_lines.Adam: You are a self-employed electrician, so your days go from job to job across the county in your van. You share a rented house with two housemates, and you usually spend evenings gaming or at the pub with friends.
private_lines.Jean: You work part-time as a receptionist at the GP surgery, three mornings a week. You live with Keith in the semi on the edge of town, and your days are filled with gardening, a book club and helping at the church café.

text: Who's coming next sat? 🥶 forecast looks bitter
I'm in if I'm not on. Rota out on mon so I'll know then
Ok 👍 keith? Adam? Jean?
Prob. Got a job over in leicester til about 5 so might be late if I come
Will be there tho
Yes
Keith says yes. I will bring the flask. Who has the barcode printouts this week?
No idea but I'll sort them, will be there early
Off for my swim now, back about 2
[photo: consumer unit I've been swearing at since 9]
1970s wiring
Is it fixable or do they need the whole rewire
Rewire. Dont tell them yet
Reminder everyone, 9am start on Saturday. Keith says the car park by the leisure centre is shut for the works so use the library one.
Library car park noted. Marking now, dont talk to me until 9
Ha. Are we doing coffee after or is the cafe still shut
Open I think. Jean?
Yes open. I'll help on the urn after the run.
Ran before school. Frost on the canal path 🥶
Rota's out. I'm off the 5th so I'm in
Told the customer about the consumer unit. They're not happy
Was not my fault
[photo: the church café urn, descaled and gleaming]
Ready for Saturday
Back from shift. Long one
Barcodes still not sorted then?
Printing tomorrow before school. Promise
Marking done. Going to bed before the cats decide otherwise
Printing barcodes at home, school printer's dead again
Printed. 23 of them 🖨️
Who's laminating
I have the laminator from the church. Can bring them Saturday
Or Keith can drop them round. Keith?
Still in leicester. Customer wants the rewire quote in writing. Lovely
Not gonna lie I'm the cheap option here
Adam did you tell them about the rewire or are you still sitting on it
Told them. They want a second opinion
Day shifts this week. Can drop them off Wed if needed
Wed is fine. Thank you
[photo: 23 barcodes laminated in a neat pile]
Done
Legend 👍
Library car park closes at 8 on weekends?
Not sure. Thought it was open all day
Might just check the sign on sat
It's pay and display after 6 I think. Bring coins
Or Adam parks on the road like always
Always works
Bed. Cats have started the usual campaign
Still up with a book that's getting worse by the chapter
